name: Heng Yang
title: Assistant Professor of Electrical Engineering
department: Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences; Electrical and Computer Engineering
fitReason: A close methodological match for CS-based embodied AI: the Computational Robotics Group combines generative policy learning, cross-domain adaptation and formal optimization with actual manipulator experiments.

physicalEvidence.summary: BEACON (May 9, 2026) co-trains diffusion visuomotor policies using simulated and limited real demonstrations, then evaluates on a physical Franka Panda for block stacking and mug cleanup. Real demonstrations number 40 per task. The lab hosts the project and identifies coauthor Han Qi as a current PhD student; Qi’s own page independently confirms Yang as adviser. Physical threading is not claimed: the real-results table reports only stacking and mug cleanup.

shortVisit.summary: The live Joining page welcomes motivated master’s and undergraduate students, but does not explicitly identify an external visiting-student route, duration or summer 2027 opportunity. The People page lists several former external master’s researchers; this is historical precedent only. Short-visit evidence remains zero pending an explicit external route.

unknowns: Existing Harvard policy audit identifies the SEAS Fellow category as including external graduates with a bachelor’s degree, but ordinarily requiring at least three months. Eight weeks is shorter; an exception or alternative appointment has not been verified.

The FAS Fellow handbook allows self-funded unpaid fellows, but this does not waive the SEAS duration requirement or HIO/department approval. The existing audit’s monetary threshold is dated and must be rechecked for 2027.

The physical study is restricted to quasi-static tasks; reported stacking success uses both relaxed and sustained criteria. Its real-world average should not be confused with simulator success or interpreted as broad dynamic manipulation.
Yang also publicly lists a part-time NVIDIA research appointment. This record is the current Harvard faculty role, not an industry internship.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
